verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical: a stacked skyscraper with a lime panel that runs edge to edge, and body copy close to headline size, which weakens the hierarchy. The VOLTSTRIDE box nearly fills the width, and an awkward strip of stripes is left below the CTA. A has more breathing room around the '48H ONLY' badge, while in B the badge is jammed into the top-left corner, nearly touching the canvas edge.
